prospective_boundary.selection_rule: Accept only exact attributed decisions at or after capture_start_ms; subtract the frozen cumulative readiness baseline.

hypothesis_formation_evidence.reason: The open lifecycle and its excursion were observed before this exit-policy experiment was frozen.

exit_policy_diagnostic.evaluation_join: Match only post-boundary route lifecycle identities to checkpoint-authored per-lifecycle profit-lock evidence.
limitations: The transported policies are not BRENTOIL-native and have no current BRENTOIL expectancy claim.
Open counterfactual economics exclude future funding and additional exit slippage.
Route lifecycle resolution alone does not establish a profit-lock benefit.
No policy may affect the live V58 exit contract without a separate approval-ready proposal and explicit human approval.

minimum_diagnostic_evidence.long: At least one post-boundary attributable eligible long decision and fully resolved long lifecycle.
minimum_diagnostic_evidence.short: At least one post-boundary attributable eligible short decision and fully resolved short lifecycle.
minimum_diagnostic_evidence.matching_policy_evidence: Each accepted lifecycle must have complete checkpoint-authored per-policy evidence and exact actual fill, fee, funding, slippage, stop, and exit attribution.

decision: Collect exact future-only BRENTOIL long and short lifecycle evidence without changing V58 execution.
